Ralts

Psychic Fairy

Hoenn · Generation 3

Ralts is a Psychic/Fairy-type Feeling Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.4 m tall and weighs 6.6 kg. It evolves into Kirlia. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (45), with a base stat total of 198.
